title: Ping Identity Migration Profile
description: Machine-readable operator declaration of migration choices for the Ping Identity → Entra migration framework. Nested under migration_profile: in .secops/identity/ping.yaml.

identity_authority.description: Who is the authoritative identity source: PingFederate, PingOne, AIC, an upstream HRIS, or mixed per-attribute.

federation_source.description: Which Ping product issues SAML/OIDC tokens today. Determines the federation trust direction gate.

hris_system.description: Name of the HRIS system (e.g. workday, successfactors). Required when identity_authority is hris or mixed; otherwise null.

per_class_ownership.description: Authoritative WRITER for each object class. Only classes declared 'entra' accept writes from migration tooling.

saml_sp_connections.description: PingFederate SP connections are a distinct migration unit — Ping-owned until explicitly migrated.

per_attribute_authority.description: Optional per-field authority overrides (e.g. manager from HRIS, custom attrs from Ping).

authority.description: Which system is authoritative for this attribute.

cutover_shape.description: How the cutover will be executed: all at once, app-by-app, or population-by-population.

group_strategy.description: lift_and_shift: recreate all Ping groups in Entra as-is. rationalize: map to Entra dynamic groups / access packages.

federation_direction.description: Federation trust direction during and after migration.

mfa_strategy.description: How users will re-enroll MFA in Entra after cutover. pingid_reenroll = PingID-specific re-enrollment campaign.

nameid_strategy.description: How PingFederate NameID formats are mapped for Entra SAML. Critical blocker gate — see skills/ping/decisions/03-nameid-strategy.md.

dry_run.description: When true, all state-changing operations are simulated — no live writes.

entra_write_tooling.description: Tooling used for Entra-side writes. none = read-only / not yet configured.
